d:
India's focus on EVs isn't merely an environmental initiative. With government backing and substantial investments, the country's landscape is rapidly changing, giving rise to new opportunities, cutting-edge technologies, and a thriving job market. From globally competitive manufacturers to innovative startups, India is setting trends that the rest of the world is watching.
Are EVs affordable? How are charging infrastructures developing? What models are available in the market? We dive into the complete breakdown, demystifying misconceptions and highlighting the real potential of EVs in India.
